## mourner-d17 — bearer <redacted> to Caleb
> YOU PICK [gq:open:take] 
YOU: "What do you think?"
NPC: "My take? We're not going to like the answer, whatever it is. Anyway."

> YOU PICK [dlg:subject] 
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "...Anyway. Sorry. What's on your mind? You'd know about that."

> YOU PICK [ask:lately] 
YOU: "What's new with you? Anything good, bad, or weird?"
NPC: "Good question." "Darmi is gone and Marco is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "We lost Darmi and Marco this week. I keep setting out extra portions. Stupid."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:grief] 
YOU: "About grief — we never finished."
NPC: "About grief — yeah, we never did get back to that."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "I'm here. Go on."
NPC: A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "Heh. Nobody's asked me that in a while. ...I'm alright. Getting there."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: A long exhale. "I'll get there. Just needed a minute where I didn't have to be fine."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "I'm here. Go on."
NPC: "Alright — I should get back to it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

### FULL TRANSCRIPT
NPC: "Why do you ask? Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
YOU: "What do you think?"
NPC: "My take? We're not going to like the answer, whatever it is. Anyway."
YOU: "Can I ask you something else?"
NPC: "...Anyway. Sorry. What's on your mind? You'd know about that."
YOU: "What's new with you? Anything good, bad, or weird?"
NPC: "Good question." "Darmi is gone and Marco is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "We lost Darmi and Marco this week. I keep setting out extra portions. Stupid."
YOU: "About grief — we never finished."
NPC: "About grief — yeah, we never did get back to that."
YOU: "I'm here. Go on."
NPC: A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "Heh. Nobody's asked me that in a while. ...I'm alright. Getting there."
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: A long exhale. "I'll get there. Just needed a minute where I didn't have to be fine."
YOU: "I'm here. Go on."
NPC: "Alright — I should get back to it."
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: They shake their head, then nod — both true at once. "Talk to me a bit. That helps more than anything."
NPC: "Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
NPC: They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."

CARRY-FLAGS: mourn=true namedMourn=true packMention=false want=seek_comfort
